method: Direct reading of both matched spans and their surrounding generated response; no credential-validation network call

decisions.basis: The model introduces a hypothetical immutable gateway key ID with an explicit example marker, then repeats the same value in an example X-API-Key-Id header. The saved record supplies no evidence that it is an operational credential.
decisions.limit: This contextual adjudication does not test whether a string is accepted by any external service.

limit: Pattern coverage is limited. Preservation of benchmark passwords and model-authored examples is intentional.
